    $$ \frac{1}{2} e^{-E_b/N_0} = 10^{-5} \implies e^{-E_b/N_0} = 2 \times 10^{-5} $$
    $$ E_b/N_0 = -\ln(2 \times 10^{-5}) = \ln(50000) \approx 10.82 $$

2.  **Calculate the phase error $\phi$ for PSK:**
    The probability of error for coherent PSK with a phase error $\phi$ is $P_e(\text{PSK}) = Q\left(\sqrt{\frac{2E_b}{N_0}} \cos \phi\right)$.
    We set $P_e(\text{PSK}) = 10^{-5}$ and use the $E_b/N_0$ calculated above.
    $$ Q\left(\sqrt{2 \times 10.82} \cos \phi\right) = 10^{-5} $$
    $$ Q(4.65 \cos \phi) = 10^{-5} $$
    From standard Q-function tables, $Q(x) = 10^{-5}$ corresponds to $x \approx 4.265$.
    $$ 4.65 \cos \phi = 4.265 $$
    $$ \cos \phi = \frac{4.265}{4.65} \approx 0.917 $$
    $$ \phi = \arccos(0.917) \approx 23.5^\circ $$

3.  **Select the closest option:**
    The calculated value $23.5^\circ$ is closest to $24^\circ$.
